newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil will post $800 mln Nov trade deficit - TV.
newsitem.headline: Brazil will post $800 mln Nov trade deficit - TV.

text.p: Brazil posted a roughly $800 million trade deficit in November, with exports reaching $4.112 billion and imports of close to $5.0 billion, a report on local TV Globo television said.
The figure is down sharply from October's record $1.3 billion trade gap, which heightened concerns among analysts and economists about Brazil's external accounts.

TV Globo, citing as its source "a senior member of the government's economic team," said Brasilia plans to release the November trade data "before lunch" today, adding the numbers were ready on Thursday.
Brazil is expected to post a 1996 trade deficit of between $.5 billion and $5 billion.
